subject: Re: Outstanding Invoice INV-7890 — next steps and exec involvement
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@horizonai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Invoice INV-7890 — overdue and next steps

Hi Maria,

Following up on invoice INV-7890 (EUR 112,450) which was due on 2026-11-15. We haven't received payment or a PO confirmation yet — the invoice and payment instructions are attached.

Can you confirm whether Horizon AI expects to:
- Pay the full amount by close of next week, or
- Sign a short payment plan (we can accept staged ACH payments)

If there's a VAT or procurement hold, please flag the exact blocker so we can loop in the right teams on our end. If helpful, we can put together a one-page mutual action plan to unblock collection without impacting service.

Attachments: INV-7890.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@horizonai.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Horizon AI Procurement <payments@horizonai.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-7890 — overdue and next steps

Aditya — thanks for the note and for attaching the invoice. Apologies for the delay. Procurement has delayed payment while our tax team verifies a VAT reverse-charge assertion for the cross-border portion of this invoice. We expect formal confirmation from our tax counsel by 2026-12-10.

In the interim, Horizon can offer:
- A 30% partial payment (ACH) by 2026-12-07, and
- The remainder on receipt of the VAT position (aiming for 2026-12-20)

I'm attaching the PO we raised (PO-34567). If Redwood needs the partial payment early or an exec-level acknowledgement to hold services, please confirm. We want to avoid any disruption while tax is reviewed.

Attachment: PO-34567.pdf

Best,
Maria Gomez
Director, Finance Operations
Horizon AI
maria.gomez@horizonai.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@horizonai.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-7890 — overdue and next steps

Thanks Maria — and thanks for the partial payment offer. Aditya and I discussed internally; given the size of the invoice and the VAT uncertainty, we'd like to formalize a short mutual action plan so both sides have clear milestones. Proposed quick checklist below (I attached a draft MAS):

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- 2026-12-07: Horizon posts 30% partial payment (EUR 33,735) — evidence to be emailed to payments@redwood.com
- 2026-12-10: Horizon provides tax counsel confirmation on VAT reverse-charge status (or expected ETA)
- 2026-12-20: Remaining balance becomes payable or alternative agreed schedule executed
- Redwood: no service interruption during this timeline provided the 30% payment is received on or before 2026-12-07

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx

If the partial payment is delayed beyond 12/07, we'll need a formal exec touchpoint to approve continued service without a payment. Naomi, can you review and advise if we're comfortable committing to the proposed guardrails or if we should escalate to Markus and finance?

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Sr. Account Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@horizonai.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Horizon AI Procurement <payments@horizonai.com>, Denton & Co Legal <contracts@dentonlaw.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T15:34:00-08:00
Subject: Escalation: Executive alignment on INV-7890 payment path

Maria / team — Naomi here (Head of Revenue Operations). Thanks for the constructive proposed plan. To remove ambiguity and protect both parties, Redwood leadership will approve a one-time accommodation under these explicit conditions:

1) Horizon posts the 30% partial payment (EUR 33,735) by 2026-12-10 and emails confirmation to payments@redwood.com.
2) Horizon provides either (a) a tax counsel memo confirming the VAT reverse-charge application or (b) a signed DocuSign amendment acknowledging the payment schedule by 2026-12-20. We are willing to accept the DocuSign path as a last-resort operational guarantee while counsel completes review.
3) If neither (1) nor (2) are met by 2026-12-20, Redwood reserves the right to suspend data exports and new model deployments for Horizon until full resolution. We prefer to avoid service disruption but must limit credit risk.

Naomi is happy to join a 20-minute exec call this week if helpful (please propose times). Markus (cc'd) from Finance will sign off on the temporary accommodation once we receive evidence of partial payment.

Links: HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HLZN-2026-INV7890
DocuSign (mutual action): https://www.docusign.com/en/explore#envelope/abc123-mutual-action

Attachments: INV-7890.pdf, PO-34567.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
